archetype: Premium Material-Minimalism (Blend of Swiss High-Contrast & Organic Earthy)

motion_and_interactions.fade_in_up: transition-all duration-800 ease-out transform translate-y-0 opacity-100 starting:-translate-y-8 starting:opacity-0

StickyHeader.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF7F5]/80 border-b border-[#E7E5E4] flex items-center justify-between px-6 md:px-12
StickyHeader.details: Logo left (Cabinet Grotesk), centered nav links (Satoshi, text-sm uppercase), cart/search icons right. Ensure text contrasts well.

ProductTheaterHero.classes: relative pt-[120px] pb-24 px-6 md:px-12 flex flex-col items-center text-center bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-[#E2E8F0]/30 to-[#FAF7F5]
ProductTheaterHero.details: 72px tracking-tight headline. 21:9 image container below text, spanning wide. Image should have 'max-h-[80vh] object-cover rounded-md'. Floating Material Highlight Badges absolute positioned on the image corners.

MaterialBadge.classes: absolute backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border border-stone-200 px-4 py-2 rounded-sm shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2
MaterialBadge.details: Contains a small color swatch (e.g. wood or brass color) and uppercase material text. Use lucide-react icons if needed.

InteractiveModelSelection.card_classes: h-[480px] bg-white border border-stone-200 cursor-pointer transition-all duration-500 hover:scale-[1.02] flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden
InteractiveModelSelection.details: 3-card grid for Brass, Bronze, Acrylic/LED. Include image filling top 70%, text info at bottom 30%. Add a 'Select' button that appears on active.

EditorialPhilosophy.image_item_classes: relative aspect-[3/4] overflow-hidden grayscale hover:grayscale-0 transition-all duration-700
EditorialPhilosophy.details: Split layout. Left text (Cabinet Grotesk H2 + Satoshi body). Right staggered 4-image grid showcasing craftsmanship. First column shifted down via mt-12.

FeatureWalkthrough.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto
FeatureWalkthrough.details: Use for Home, Office, Apartment contexts. Minimalist icons (lucide-react), large numerals (01, 02, 03), short descriptive text.

SpecificationTable.details: Horizontal dividers only. Columns: Feature, Brass, Bronze, Acrylic. Clean Satoshi font, text-sm or text-base.

CustomerReviews.details: Highlight 4.9/5 rating and 128 reviews. Minimalist grid of 3 review cards. Cards: border border-stone-200, p-8, left-aligned text.

StickyCheckoutBar.classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-stone-200 p-4 md:p-6 z-40 flex items-center justify-between lg:justify-center lg:gap-24 shadow-[0_-4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] transition-transform duration-300
StickyCheckoutBar.button_classes: bg-[#1C1917] text-[#FAF7F5] px-8 py-3 rounded-sm hover:bg-[#292524] transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 text-sm uppercase tracking-wider font-medium
StickyCheckoutBar.details: Shows currently selected model, price or 'Request Quote', and a WhatsApp CTA button.

hero_product.alt: Blank white sign on textured wall
hero_product.description: Used for Hero Theater 21:9 image container

icons.usage: Use MapPin for location, Phone for contact, Star for reviews, ShoppingCart for header, Search for header, MessageCircle for WhatsApp CTA, Check for active states.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, model selection cards, checkout bar) must include data-testid. E.g. data-testid="nav-home-link", data-testid="model-card-brass", data-testid="checkout-whatsapp-btn".

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Satoshi' via fontsource or google fonts, or apply generic fallback styling simulating them (e.g. tightly tracked geometric sans).
Construct the UI in single landing page structure.
Implement the Interactive Model Selection as a React state that updates the Sticky Checkout Bar at the bottom.
Apply the grayscale-to-color hover effect precisely as specified in the Editorial section using Tailwind group-hover or direct hover classes.
Ensure 'Stone-50' (#FAF7F5) is the primary body background, avoiding pure white except for specific cards.
For the Feature Walkthrough, use dark mode inverse colors (#1C1917 bg).
Build the Specification Table cleanly with Tailwind table utility classes, hiding vertical borders.
Do not use generic placeholder images; use the provided image URLs.
